fact_text: In the analyst's view Hub Power's consolidated final results were positive, and the market reacted well to them.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC & MTL Stock Analysis: Dividend Prospects, and Investment Insights | PSX Market Review' (YouTube, 2024-08-27)

fact_text: Hub Power's consolidated profit has been reported at about PKR 49 to 50 billion in recent years, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC & MTL Stock Analysis: Dividend Prospects, and Investment Insights | PSX Market Review' (YouTube, 2024-08-27)

fact_text: Hub Power holds a 47.5 percent stake in China Power Hub Generation, which operates the coal project the analyst referred to.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC & MTL Stock Analysis: Dividend Prospects, and Investment Insights | PSX Market Review' (YouTube, 2024-08-27)

fact_text: Hub Power is linked to Mega Motors, which brings BYD vehicles to Pakistan; using a hypothetical 10,000 BYD units sold, the analyst said Hub Power should see some benefit.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC & MTL Stock Analysis: Dividend Prospects, and Investment Insights | PSX Market Review' (YouTube, 2024-08-27)

fact_text: The analyst cited Fazal Textile Mill's land, since redeveloped as the Lucky One Mall, as a case where asset gains did not reach minority shareholders, and said Hub Power should avoid that.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC & MTL Stock Analysis: Dividend Prospects, and Investment Insights | PSX Market Review' (YouTube, 2024-08-27)

fact_text: Millat Tractors traded at about nine times earnings on its nine-month results, according to the analyst.

fact_text: The KSE-100 price to earnings multiple was around five times, according to the analyst.

fact_text: Millat Tractors' earlier production capacity was about 42,000 units.

fact_text: Millat Tractors exports tractors to Uganda and South Africa via Dubai.

fact_text: The analyst linked possible support for Millat Tractors to SIFC corporate farming and Punjab government agriculture initiatives.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC & MTL Stock Analysis: Dividend Prospects, and Investment Insights | PSX Market Review' (YouTube, 2024-08-27)
